properties.Name: Sunny Hill
properties.Description: Sunny Hill Association is a space of cooperation, innovation, and supportive environment for research, education and active practice of sustainable development. It aims for the sustainable revitalization of the rural area of Slovene Istra. The core of the community are the Cooperative members,  longer-term inhabitants and shorter-term guests, visitors, and volunteers. They explore combining modern and traditional solutions for social and environmental challenges. Association Sunny Hill organises workshops, retreats, conferences and events immersed in pristine nature. Their Cooperative owns and leases land and houses.

properties.Name: Kardokai Ecovillage
properties.Description: Kardokai Ecovillage is a collection of family homesteads on 40ha of land, in Lithuania. The project started in 2010 and currently has 45 members. Permaculture and community life are two pillars of life in Kardokai. There are 15 straw-bale buildings which consist of houses, small homes and school buildings. Kardokai Natur School was established in 2017 and organises seminars on straw bale constructions and hosts ecovillage festivals.

properties.Name: Ecoaldea de Valdepiélagos
properties.Description: The project started in 1993, after a long period of consolidation of the group and design of the space, towards 2002 the works began, the houses were delivered in 2008. They are located on Valdepiélagos, bordering the urban area of the town, and have built 30 houses of two floors and basement, with land of 750 square meters, where they have their gardens.

properties.Name: Sunseed Desert Technology
properties.Description:
We are a non-formal education project for the social ecological
transition in Andalucía, southern Spain. With more than 35 years of
play, work, research, learning and experimenting, we aim to inspire and
involve people from around the world to join the movement towards a
culture of people and planet care.

properties.Name: Zeleno Doba Center for sustainable growth and development
properties.Description: The Center for Sustainable Growth and Development - Green Age, based in Serbia, is a dedicated community of individuals spanning various fields and ages, united by a shared passion for creating a hub for research, education, empowerment, and community building. Our core mission is to harmonize human life with the laws of nature. Through education, empowerment, and networking, we actively support and advocate for the development of sustainable communities, initiatives, and individuals.

properties.Name: Feminine Wisdom MatriCulture School
properties.Description: Feminine Wisdom Matriculture School is a collective of experienced women facilitators in matriarchal, feminist, ecological, spiritual, and social studies, dedicated to teaching the knowledge and skills needed to design regenerative, matriarchal communities that honor planetary boundaries. We are an embodied women's think-tank cultivating sacred, inclusive spaces for deep introspection, healing, and collective empowerment, rooted in the wisdom of indigenous matriarchal societies and the Earth’s natural cycles. Our programs (such as the SHE-EDE) blend feminist ecological design, gift economy, and spiritual practice to support women in becoming agents of compassionate change for a just and thriving future.

properties.Name: TU I TERRA Foundation
properties.Description: TU i TERRA is established foundation (registered in January 2024) created by the experienced educational association Kobiety.lodz.pl (Łódź, Poland), active in youth and adult education and Erasmus+ projects since 2000. In 2023, our team acquired an old farm in a remote area of the Lubelskie region in Poland,and founded TU i TERRA to transform it into a rural educational hub focused on nature education, regeneration, organic farming, and community development.  We work locally and internationally

properties.Name: Kispetri Transition Project
properties.Description: The Kispetri Agro-Ecological Collective is a community of families in Petrinzel, Romania, operating as a permaculture centre and farm. It integrates a registered agro-ecological goat farm with a non-profit association that promotes village social projects and organic farming education. Through regenerative land stewardship and cultural exchange, the project bridges traditional rural heritage with modern ecological innovation.

properties.Name: Satsumania Village
properties.Description:
Satsumania Village is a small ecovillage initiative located in Badembükü, Karaburun, on the westernmost peninsula of Türkiye. Through our Global Ecovillage Network (GEN) activities and our “Western Villages Living Heritage Map” project, we work to preserve local culture, traditional knowledge, biodiversity, and sustainable rural livelihoods.
Our initiative connects visitors with local producers, artisans, and residents while supporting regenerative tourism, ecological awareness, and intergenerational knowledge sharing. We believe that protecting cultural heritage and nature together is essential for creating resilient rural communities.
